index 961fc1a..537fab3 100644
--- a/src/stats.py
+++ b/src/stats.py
@@ -10,4 +10,17 @@ def median(xs):
     """Median of a non-empty list of numbers."""
     s = sorted(xs)
     n = len(s)
-    return s[n // 2]
+    if n % 2 == 1:
+        return s[n // 2]
+    else:
+        return (s[n // 2 - 1] + s[n // 2]) / 2
+
+
+def mode(xs):
+    """Mode of a non-empty list of numbers: the most common value, smallest on ties."""
+    from collections import Counter
+    counts = Counter(xs)
+    max_count = max(counts.values())
+    modes = [k for k, v in counts.items() if v == max_count]
+    return min(modes)
+
